mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that triggers central bank stimulus and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise consecutively for 2 months, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery, a rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals improving manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during post-recession recovery when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL y/y exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates improving labor market conditions that support consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals central bank stimulus amid inflation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals potential housing market slowdown, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.
